target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Locally owned and operated out of Ashtabula, Ohio. Services: excavation, demolition, and land projects throughout Northeast Ohio. Offers free estimates and can work alongside insurance companies. Strong online reviews indicate customer-focused approach. Testimonials highlight professionalism, punctuality, fair pricing, and quality work. Active Facebook presence. Small growing business that would benefit significantly from streamlined earthwork estimation tools.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Commercial, industrial, and municipal contractor specializing in Site development, earthwork, industrial general construction and underground utilities (storm sewer, detention systems, sanitary sewer, pump stations, water main construction). Experienced workforce with 30 Hr. OSHA training, certified background checks, 20+ years field experience per foreman. Technology: Trimble GPS field surveying, satellite grading controls, in-site digitizing earthwork software, HCSS Heavy Bid/Heavy Job, drone documentation. Large fleet of heavy equipment with certified tier four master mechanic. EarthFlow Estimator would integrate with their existing technology stack.
